headline: The paper is still damp.
body: A delivery van takes the corner too wide and leaves a wet arc on the stones. Inside, the clock has jumped a minute and no one has corrected it. We leave the night under unfinished and open the window a finger.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: high pewter, no rain yet, one pale seam east

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: low and sideways, only on the left wall

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: brake hiss, a wet arc, one shutter still down
